headline: Lund-Iversen scores six of Mercy's nine
dek: The senior forward has taken twelve shots and made one assist beside the six goals. Mercy have lost only on opening day, to East Stroudsburg at home, and have won three times and drawn once since.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Queens have scored more than Roberts Wesleyan and Staten Island together, and nine different players have done the scoring; the spread of the attack, not one striker, is what sets them apart.

wire.line: District of Columbia have won three and lost once, on five goals scored; Lorenzo Herrera has made 31 saves behind them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches are past their date with no result published: District of Columbia's opening-day trip to Shepherd and Molloy's at Caldwell.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Daemen have conceded fifteen goals, more than any other programme, and two draws, at Saint Michael's and at home to Salem, are all they have to show.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Queens have scored sixteen goals, more than any other programme, and conceded five; the defeat at Holy Family is the only match they have lost.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: D'Youville have won their last two, at California and at home to Pitt-Johnstown, without conceding, and Matthew Solorio now has four clean sheets.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Six different players have scored Roberts Wesleyan's eight goals; nine conceded have held the side to one win.

last_match.line: Queens have scored in every match this season; Georgian Court had already beaten Staten Island earlier this month.

next_match.line: Mercy have not lost since opening day, and have won away only at Bridgeport; Adelphi held them goalless on their other trip.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
